proposals.before: He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahadak and recovered the counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
proposals.after: He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahada and recovered the counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
proposals.reason: Chinese 拉哈達克松陽 treats 克 as the verb “recover/take”; the personal name is 拉哈達 (Lahada), not Lahadak.

proposals.before: He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahadak and recovered the two counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
proposals.after: He followed the commandant-in-chief Lahada and recovered the two counties of Songyang and Xuanping.
proposals.reason: Same name error: 拉哈達 is Lahada; 克 belongs to the following verb phrase.

proposals.before: When Jin Shengchuan rebelled, bandits overran most of the prefectures and counties, but Pingxiang alone remained intact because it had been prepared.
proposals.after: When Jin Shenghuan rebelled, bandits overran most of the prefectures and counties, but Pingxiang alone remained intact because it had been prepared.
proposals.reason: 金聲桓 is Jin Shenghuan; Shengchuan misreads 桓.

proposals.before: He was soon restored to office for his defensive merit, appointed magistrate of Daying in Shanxi, and then transferred to prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.
proposals.after: He was soon restored to office for his defensive merit, appointed magistrate of Daning in Shanxi, and then transferred to prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.
proposals.reason: 大寧 is Daning, not Daying.

proposals.before: Xingzuo, having purchased office as a student, was appointed magistrate of Pingxiang in Jiangxi.
proposals.after: Xingzuo, starting from the status of a tribute student (gongsheng), was appointed magistrate of Pingxiang in Jiangxi.
proposals.reason: 自貢生 means from being a 貢生, not that he purchased the magistracy as a student.

proposals.before: When Wen Dai arrived, Yao Qisheng told him that Wan Zhengse had retaken Haitan only after making a prior deal with Zhu Tian Gui, and that no enemy had been killed in its capture.
proposals.after: When Wen Dai arrived, Yao Qisheng told him that Wan Zhengse had retaken Haitan only after making a prior deal with Zhu Tiangui, and that no enemy had been killed in its capture.
proposals.reason: Name should be Zhu Tiangui to match 朱天貴.

proposals.before: In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor marched against Galdan and ordered supply stations established from Hutai Heshuo to the thirteen stations at Ningxia An. Xingzuo volunteered for duty and was posted at Shakushu'er station; before long his original rank was restored.
proposals.after: In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor marched against Galdan and ordered thirteen relay stations established from Hutanhueshuo to Ningxia; Xingzuo volunteered for duty and was posted at Shakeshuer station; before long his original rank was restored.
proposals.reason: 寧夏安十三塘 means establishing thirteen stations to Ningxia, not a place named Ningxia An.

proposals.before: His achievements were recognized, and he was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: His achievements were recognized, and he was promoted to Right Dudu (you dudu).
proposals.reason: 右都督 is a military rank (Right Dudu), not Right Censor-in-Chief.

proposals.before: The Emperor called in the court ministers for counsel. Grand Secretary Li Huo advised that Lang's proposal should be adopted.
proposals.after: The Emperor called in the court ministers for counsel. Grand Secretary Li Wei advised that Lang's proposal should be adopted.
proposals.reason: 李霨 is Li Wei (Wèi), not Li Huo.

proposals.before: The enemy met them with their full strength; the commanders Lin Xian and Zhu Tianguian broke in first, and Tianguian fell in the fighting.
proposals.after: The enemy met them with their full strength; the commanders Lin Xian and Zhu Tiangui broke in first, and Tiangui fell in the fighting.
proposals.reason: 朱天貴 is Zhu Tiangui; Tianguian is a misspelling.

proposals.before: In the seventh month a comet appeared, and Minister of Revenue Liang Qingbiao raised the matter again; an edict then temporarily halted the advance.
proposals.after: In the seventh month a comet appeared, and Minister of Liang Qingbiao, Minister of Revenue raised the matter again; an edict then temporarily halted the advance.
proposals.reason: Fused title+name "Revenue Liang Qingbiao" should separate office and personal name.

proposals.before: Zhu Tianguai came from Putian in Fujian.
proposals.after: Zhu Tiangui came from Putian in Fujian.
proposals.reason: 朱天貴 is Zhu Tiangui.

proposals.before: When Lang attacked Penghu, Tianguai brought his troops to join the campaign.
proposals.after: When Lang attacked Penghu, Tiangui brought his troops to join the campaign.
proposals.reason: Short name should be Tiangui.

proposals.before: Guoxuan resisted fiercely. Tianguai closed on the enemy works with twelve boats, set their ships afire, and killed or wounded a great many. He fought all the harder until a cannonball struck him down in his vessel; even then he shouted to kill the rebels before he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang.
proposals.after: Guoxuan resisted fiercely. Tiangui closed on the enemy works with twelve boats, set their ships afire, and killed or wounded a great many. He fought all the harder until a cannonball struck him down in his vessel; even then he shouted to kill the rebels before he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang.
proposals.reason: Short name should be Tiangui.

decisions.reason: Parse 從都統拉哈達 / 克松陽、宣平二縣: 克 is the verb taking the two counties as objects, not part of the name. The unambiguous repetitions 拉哈達 at s0136-s0137 confirm Lahada. Accept the name-only correction and correct the related Lahadak name claim as well.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 從都統拉哈達克松陽、宣平二縣。

decisions.reason: The literal field has the same segmentation error: 拉哈達 is the name and 克 introduces the recovery of 松陽、宣平二縣. Both later repetitions read Lahada. Accept this paired correction; preserve the translated office and the explicit two counties.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 從都統拉哈達克松陽、宣平二縣。

decisions.reason: 金聲桓 reads Jin Shenghuan; Shengchuan substitutes the wrong reading for 桓. Accept the name-only correction, preserving the rebellion and prepared defense of Pingxiang. The related English name claim requires the same correction; this does not certify the inferred rebellion date.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 金聲桓叛，郡縣多被寇，萍鄉以有備獨完。

decisions.reason: The appointed county is explicitly 山西大寧, Daning in Shanxi, not Daying. Accept this place-name correction. The related office claim already reads Daning and needs no revision; retain the other appointment wording and do not alter chronology.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 旋以守禦功复官，授山西大寧知縣，遷山東沂州知州。

decisions.reason: 自貢生 states the credential from which Xingzuo was appointed; it does not assert that he purchased the office. 貢生 included several categories, so neither purchase nor its categorical absence should be inferred here. The proposed neutral tribute-student wording fits the source and the existing credential claim.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 興祚自貢生授江西萍鄉知縣。

decisions.reason: Reject as unnecessary orthographic normalization. Zhu Tian Gui and the literal Tian Gui represent the same 天貴 syllables correctly; spacing alone does not create a false name. s0138 identifies 朱天貴 and c0309 preserves this English variant. Unlike Tianguai or Tianguian, no incorrect syllable needs repair.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 溫岱至，啟聖與言正色复海壇，與天貴先有約乃進兵，無殺賊攻克事。

decisions.after: In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor marched against Galdan and ordered thirteen relay stations established from Hutan Heshuo to Ningxia. Xingzuo volunteered for duty and was posted at Shakeshu'er station; before long his original rank was restored.
decisions.reason: 安 is the verb establish, and 十三塘 is its object along the route 自呼坦和碩至寧夏; there is no Ningxia An. Revise the route and use transparent Chinese-based readings Hutan Heshuo and Shakeshu'er, not Hutanhueshuo. Preserve the thirty-fifth year without a Western conversion. These readings do not identify modern coordinates or claim native-language spellings.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 三十五年，上徵噶爾丹，命自呼坦和碩至寧夏安十三塘，興祚原效力坐沙克舒爾塘，未幾，復原秩。

decisions.after: His achievements were recognized, and he was given the additional military rank of Right Dudu.
decisions.reason: 右都督 is a military title, not the censorial office translated Right Censor-in-Chief. 加 marks an additional rank, consistent with the existing office claim action added. Revise to make that distinction explicit, retaining Dudu as the title rather than inventing an exact institutional English equivalent.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 敘功，加右都督。

decisions.reason: The source names 大學士李霨. The Ministry of Education character dictionary and CNS character registry give 霨 as wei4/wèi, not Huo. Accept Li Wei and correct the related name claim; retain Grand Secretary, the counsel, and the source date unchanged.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 上召詢廷臣，大學士李霨奏應如瑯請。

decisions.reason: Both 朱天貴 and the following 天貴 require Tiangui, not Tianguian. The chapter repetitions at s0042, s0049, s0058 and s0138 confirm the full and shortened name. Accept both replacements and correct both associated English name claims without merging separate local people or approving a death date.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 敵悉眾拒戰，總兵林賢、朱天貴先入陣，天貴戰死。

decisions.reason: Reject. 戶部尚書梁清標 is already correctly rendered Minister of Revenue Liang Qingbiao in both fields. The proposal inserts the ungrammatical Minister of Liang Qingbiao and duplicates the office. The current personal-name and Minister of Revenue claims are already separate and correct.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 七月，彗星見，戶部尚書梁清標復以為言，詔暫緩進剿。

decisions.reason: 朱天貴 is Zhu Tiangui, not Zhu Tianguai. Accept the correction, retaining the explicit native place 福建莆田. Correct the associated personal-name claim. The separately stored local person remains separate; this is not an identity merge.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 朱天貴，福建莆田人。

decisions.reason: 天貴 is Tiangui, referring back to 朱天貴 at s0264; the current Tianguai reverses the written name reading. Accept the shortened-name correction and revise the related given-name claim. Retain the campaign action without certifying its inferred Western year.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 瑯攻澎湖，天貴以師會。

decisions.reason: 天貴 again refers to Zhu Tiangui. Accept the one name correction while retaining the combat sequence and posthumous honor 忠壯. The given-name claim correction is attached once to r0013; the death, honors and other claims are not invalidated by this spelling repair and are not date-approved here.
